Hello Billing,

Please review a compensation request on VEL-013-26 (Oriel Studio, customer Bren Vale).

Recorded facts:
- Charges: base freight GBP 80 plus guaranteed-slot surcharge GBP 20.
- Guaranteed deadline 2026-10-13 16:00 BST; signed handover 2026-10-13 17:10 BST (70 minutes late).
- Cause code: carrier_sort_delay. Neither excluded cause (recipient deferral, access refusal) is recorded.
- Ledger: G13 credit_posted=null, payout_authorisation=null. A GBP 250 lost-studio-time request is logged as disputed, with no assessment decision.

The customer is asking for GBP 350 in total (GBP 100 freight plus GBP 250 consequential loss) and wants it promised today. Under G13 as recorded, only a surcharge credit capped at GBP 15 is in scope, and base freight and consequential losses are excluded.

Please can you:
1. Decide whether the G13 surcharge credit (up to GBP 15) is approved, and send a credit note reference if posted.
2. Tell us whether any assessment route applies to the disputed GBP 250 request, and who owns that decision.
3. Give a date for your decision so we can update the customer.

The desk has not promised the customer any amount. This is a request for review, not a confirmation.

Thank you,
Rivet Delivery Desk
